text:
imogen: FYI team — we're rolling out a new Surge Mitigation & Invoice Safeguard next week. Purpose: reduce surprise bills from accidental traffic surges and protect tail latency. Draft policy + FAQ: https://redwood.internal/policies/surge-mitigate

ryan: Is this another rate limit? What will customers observe?

imogen: It's a mid-window protection (30s rolling) that can apply short pacing windows when sustained token rate looks anomalous. Not a per-sec hard limit. Customers will typically see brief pacing or a response header indicating pacing rather than immediate 429s.

mona: Will committed/dedicated customers be affected?

imogen: Committed pools are honored first; mitigation only applies if bursts exceed pool headroom or cross-pool emergencies. PAYG and free tier more likely to see pacing.

billing-bot: Billing note: tokens produced are billed as usual. If we confirm a system-side pacing error caused dropped completions, finance will evaluate automatic credits for affected invoices. See finance FAQ.

support: Adding KB with triage steps: check "surge_rate" chart, look for header X-Redwood-Surge: true, advise backoff with jitter. Will add canned responses.

imogen: Public copy will avoid scary phrasing. Suggested: "temporary request pacing to keep performance consistent during large, unexpected spikes."

ryan: Any SDK or header changes we should highlight?

imogen: Yes — we will add X-Redwood-Surge: true and Surge-Delay-Ms when active. Recommend exponential backoff starting at ~300-500ms with jitter. We'll include a curl example in docs: 

```bash
curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
# look for header: X-Redwood-Surge: true
```

mona: Rollout plan?

imogen: Canary Mon 09:00 PT to 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 36 hours with auto-abort on p99 latency +6% or error spike. Ops will monitor surge_events/min and pacing_duration distribution.

support: Confirmed playbook pushed. We'll pre-notify enterprise CSMs and post a blog + in-console banner on day of rollout.

imogen: TL;DR: Surge Mitigation + Invoice Safeguard to smooth accidental spikes, brief pacing windows possible, headers + backoff guidance, staged rollout next week. Feedback welcome. :white_check_mark:
